thread:
sam: starting the maintenance window now. kicking off merge-style migration 2026_10_merge_user_attrs. holdpoint=MANUAL_CANARY. release tag v3.4.2-db. this is a staggered wave deploy across shard groups to avoid hot-spots. we'll use quiesce signals before each shard wave.

deploybot: Migration planned: id=merge_2026_10_01, mode=staggered, holdpoint=MANUAL_CANARY, waves=[shard_group_0, shard_group_1, shard_group_2], watches=[replica-lag, db-lock-wait, error-rate], auto-rollback=false

indra: short summary: adds merged attributes table user_attrs_mv populated from joins of profiles + legacy_attrs; creates partial index and runs validation. No destructive DDL. Backfill writes are idempotent.

paul: ops run command for backfill:
```bash
./merge-backfill --migration=2026_10_merge_user_attrs --wave=shard_group_0 --batch=700 --sleep=200
```
I'll run wave0 now and stream logs. quiesce signal will be sent before wave start.

ops-bot: quiesce signal issued to service router: quiesce_id=qz_4321000001, grace_period=30s at ts=4321000010

sam: abort criteria (per runbook): 1) replica lag > 35s for >2m OR 2) avg_lock_wait > 400ms for >3m OR 3) error-rate on writes > 0.6% over 5m. If any trigger -> pause waves, pin api-service to previous image, and evaluate rollback.

indra: rollback options: because change is additive, safe rollback = stop backfill, flip feature-flag user_attrs_read=false (app falls back to legacy join), unpin service, and optionally run cleanup migration if index causes issues. full cleanup requires operator consent for index-drop (we won't auto-drop).

deploybot: WAVES STARTED: wave=shard_group_0 -> quiesce applied. watchers: @paul @indra @sam. automated breakpoints active.

paul: wave0 logs: throughput steady, p95 write latency ~120ms, no errors. continuing.

ops-bot: observed average_lock_wait=210ms at ts=4321000032 on pg-node-5; within bounds.

sam: manual ack to proceed to wave1 when wave0 finishes and index partial build reaches 30% for that group. also proposing to pin api-gateway to v3.4.1 for the duration of waves for faster rollback.

paul: wave0 complete. index partial built 34%. ack to proceed to wave1.

deploybot: scheduling wave1 in 2m. breakpoint conditions unchanged.

indra: note for private clusters: if IOwait > 55% on primary we move backfill to low-priority host pool per infra runbook. also prepare fallback to dedicated read replicas.

paul: starting wave1. quiesce signal re-issued. running with batch=500 to be conservative.

ops-bot: replica-lag spiked to 38s at ts=4321000055 during wave1. triggering automated pause and alerting watchers.

sam: got alert. initiating pause. moving traffic back off quiesced path and unquiesce router. pinning api-gateway to v3.4.0 as a quick revert path.

indra: since lag triggered pause, we will NOT run cleanup yet. stop all backfill jobs for wave1 and wave2. wait for lag to recover to <20s for 5m before resuming. if lag doesn't recover in 15m we should consider rollforward vs rollback meeting.

paul: stopped jobs. streaming stopped. I'll keep tailing logs and metrics.

sam: added short note to release notes: "DB: merge user_attrs_mv (materialized+backfill), partial concurrent index, staged waves with quiesce. Rollback: stop backfill + flip feature flag + operator-approved cleanup. Service pinning recommended during window."

deploybot: Migration paused by automation due to replica-lag. awaiting manual decision from leads.

indra: I'll start a quick sync call in 5m if lag hasn't recovered. tagging @oncall-sre.

sam: thanks all 44d will update thread after call.
